DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS).

The arterial blood gas confirms respiratory acidosis (pH 7.30, PaCO2 50 mm Hg), and the chest X-ray findings of ground-glass appearance and air bronchograms are classic for RDS in a newborn, likely due to surfactant deficiency. Are you the mother, and do you have any information regarding the gestational age of the baby?
